title: Selvage Session Protocol — the `GET /meta` negotiation body
description: The body `GET /meta` answers with, on the same listener as the session WebSocket. It is JSON but not a session frame: no `v`, no envelope, no `id`. Valid against spec/PROTOCOL.md §2.

capabilities.description: The same list the handshake reply advertises.

server.description: Free-form server identification, e.g. `selvaged/0.1.0`. Not stable; nothing may depend on it.

wire_versions.description: The wire versions this server accepts. A client that can speak none of them must not open the socket; an unreachable `/meta` decides nothing.
